news.title: The ‘Heart of Campus’ Reimagined: Renovation and Expansion Brings New Life to Chapel of Reconciliation
news.summary_en: On Friday, Sept. 18, Augustana University celebrated the rededication of the Chapel of Reconciliation following the completion of a $4.4 million donor-funded renovation and expansion project — renewing a space that has served as a place for worship, reflection and community for more than four decades.

news.title: Rediscovered Time Capsule to be Featured at Viking Days Celebration
news.summary_en: As Augustana University embarked on the renovation and expansion of its Chapel of Reconciliation, the owl statue Hindsight, Insight, Foresight was moved from its long-time home outside of Morrison Commons for refurbishment.
